is_anopheles.evidence: Study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s., An. melas) and Anopheles funestus collected on Bioko Island (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped the west African Leu-Phe kdr mutation (Vgsc L995F / L1014F) using the PCR method of Martinez-Torres et al. (Page 3, Methods; Page 4, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (Page 4) provides explicit sample sizes and genotype counts (kdr/kdr, +/kdr, +/+) for M-form An. gambiae s.s. across pre-spray and three post-spray rounds.

african_field_population.evidence: Field collections of wild mosquitoes using window traps at 16 sentinel sites on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea between December 2003 and December 2005 (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary research article reporting original entomological monitoring and kdr genotyping data for the BIMCP IRS program on Bioko Island.

sub_country_location.evidence: Samples collected at 16 sentinel sites on Bioko Island, including Punta Europa, Baney, Batete, Bilelipa, Luba, Rebola, Sacriba, Sampaka, Semu, etc. (Page 2, Figure 1; Page 4, Text).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections took place from December 2003 to December 2005 (2-year window; Page 1, Abstract).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected specifically for the entomological evaluation of the BIMCP IRS initiative during 2003-2005.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts (kdr/kdr, +/kdr, +/+) by spray round are provided in Table 2 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated vector density, sporozoite rates, and Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) mutation frequencies in Anopheles gambiae s.s. M-forms collected from 16 sentinel sites on Bioko Island, Equatorial Guinea, across pre-spray and three post-spray IRS rounds (2003–2005). Table 2 provides exact genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for 369 M-form An. gambiae s.s.
